contract_name: Frozen Final Cross-Cycle SHAP Synthesis Decision Protocol

timing_disclosure.interpretation: This is a pre-synthesis decision-rule freeze, not a preregistration before Cycle25 data were observed.

TIER_1.label: GLOBAL_STRUCTURE_ONLY_EVIDENCE
TIER_1.rule: OVERALL any_null_exceedance == True AND OVERALL total FDR-significant featurewise hypotheses == 0

TIER_2.label: GLOBAL_STRUCTURE_AND_FEATUREWISE_EVIDENCE
TIER_2.rule: OVERALL any_null_exceedance == True AND OVERALL total FDR-significant featurewise hypotheses >= 1

primary_model_evidence_rule.featurewise_condition: Sum OVERALL BH-FDR significant features across the two predefined featurewise quantities.

class_conditional.reason: Class-conditioned evidence is used to assess whether pooled attribution changes remain visible within classes rather than being explained solely by prevalence mix.

common_support_reweighting.reason: The sensitivity estimand uses a support-restricted reference population. The full-population Chapter-9 null is not validly reusable as a formal threshold.

correlated_groups.reason: Group-level metrics are descriptive robustness checks because no frozen 10-group Cycle24 null distribution exists.

temporal_blocks.reason: Temporal blocks were screened against the frozen OVERALL null, not against block-size-matched temporal nulls.

consistency_categories.CONSISTENT_ACROSS_ALL_MODELS: All 3 models receive the same primary inferential evidence tier.
consistency_categories.MAJORITY_MODEL_PATTERN: Exactly 2 of 3 models receive the same primary evidence tier.
consistency_categories.MODEL_DEPENDENT_MIXED_PATTERN: No single evidence tier describes a majority pattern cleanly.

cross_model_rule.reason: Different model families operate in different SHAP output spaces and may exhibit different attribution-drift behavior. The synthesis must preserve model-specific evidence instead of forcing a pooled raw-SHAP conclusion.

prohibited_logic: Do not classify explanation drift from featurewise FDR alone.
Do not classify stability merely because a frozen null threshold was not exceeded.
Do not reuse full-population null thresholds as formal thresholds for common-support-restricted estimates.
Do not invent group-level statistical significance without a frozen group null.
Do not treat temporal B1/B2/B3 screening as block-specific formal inference.
Do not compare raw SHAP magnitudes across LR, RF, and XGB.
Do not interpret SHAP differences as causal solar-physics effects.
interpretation_rule: The final synthesis must preserve the distinction between formal inferential evidence and descriptive robustness evidence. Primary model-level evidence tiers are based on the frozen OVERALL structure-null screen and OVERALL featurewise BH-FDR results. Class-conditional, support/reweighting, correlated-group, and temporal analyses must be reported as predefined context and robustness evidence without inventing unfrozen significance thresholds.
